en: Sceing a man, even though travelling on a car, afflicted and rendered insensible by pain, the inielligent man journeys on a car as long as there is a car-path.

sa: जिह्वोवाच नेमे बाणास्तरिष्यन्ति मामलर्क कथंचन। तवैव मर्म भेत्स्यन्ति भिन्नमर्मा मरिष्यसि॥
en: The tongue said These arrows, O Alarka, will not cut through me. They will only pierce your own vital parts and your vital parts being pierced, you shall dic.

sa: त्वगुवाच नेमे बाणास्तरिष्यन्ति मामलर्क कथंचन। तवैव मर्म भेत्स्यन्ति भिन्नमर्मा मरिष्यसि॥
en: The skin said These arrows will not, O Alarka, pass through me. They will pierce your own vital parts only, and your vital parts being pierced, you shall die.

sa: ते तं दृष्ट्वातिथिं प्राप्तं प्रहृष्टमनसोऽभवन्। तेऽभिवाद्य सुखप्रश्न पृष्ट्वा तमतिथि तदा॥
en: Seeing the person who came as a guest, all of them became highly pleased. Indeed, seeing him, they saluted him and made the usual inquiries of health and happiness.

sa: क्षमा धृतिरहिंसा च समता सत्यमार्जवम्। ज्ञानं त्यागोऽथ संन्यासः सात्त्विकं वृत्तमिष्यते॥
en: Forgiveness, courage, abstention abstention from injury, equability, truth, sincerity, knowledge, gift, and renunciation, are said to be the marks of that course of conduct which arises out of Goodness.

sa: अत उर्ध्वं निबोधेदं देवानां यष्टुमिच्छताम्। समागमे महाराज ब्रह्मणा वै स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: After this, listen to what I would say. Once on a time the gods, desirous of making a Sacrifice, went, O king, to the presence of the Self-create Brahman.

sa: दिवं गत्वा शरीरेण स्वेन राजन् यथामरः॥ स्वर्गे पुण्यं यथाकाममुपभुङ्क्ते तथाविधः।
en: Such a man, o king proceeding to the celestial region in even his own corporeal frame, enjoys all the, happiness that is there like a celestial at his will.

sa: यथैव सदृशो रूपे मातापित्रोहि जायते। व्याघ्रश्चित्रैस्तथा योनि पुरुषः स्वां नियच्छति॥
en: As the cub of a tiger resembles its father and dam in form and in stripes or spots, so a person cannot but show the circumstance of his origin.

sa: इदमन्यच्च देवर्षे रहस्यं सर्वयोषिताम्। दृष्ट्वैव पुरुषं हृद्यं योनिः प्रक्लिद्यते स्त्रियाः॥
en: This, O celestial Rishi, is another mystery about women. As soon as they see a man of beautiful and charming features, unfailing signs of desire appear on their body.

sa: ततः स पुनरारुह्य वारणप्रवरं रणे। अव्यग्रः प्रेषयामास जयार्थी विजयं प्रति॥
en: Mounting on his prince of elephants again in the midst of that battle, the son of Bhagadatta, desirous of victory, very coolly shot a number of arrows at Arjuna.

sa: यथा चाक्षय्यतां प्राप्तं पुण्यतां च यथा गतम्। सर्वमेतदशेषेण प्रवक्ष्यामि नराधिप॥
en: I shall also tell you in full, O prince, how it acquired the force of a permanent observance and how it came to be considered as a meritorious act.

sa: ईदृशश्चाप्यगस्त्यो हि कथितस्ते मयाऽनघ। ब्रवीम्यहं ब्रूहि वा त्वमगस्त्यात् क्षत्रियं वरम्॥
en: O sinless one, so was Agastya as described by me. Shall I continue? Or, will you say anything in reply? Is there any Kshatriya who is greater than Agastya?

sa: यस्तु प्रातस्तथा सायं भुजानो नान्तरा पिबेत्। अहिंसानिरतो नित्यं जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्॥ षभिः स वषैर्नृपते सिध्यते नात्र संशयः। अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः॥
en: That man who eats once in the forenoon and once after evening and abstains from drinking at the interval, and who shows mercy towards all creatures, and pours libations of clarified butter on his sacred fire every day, acquires success, O king, in six years. There is no doubt in this. Such a man acquires the merit of the Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: चैत्रं तु नियतो मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत्। सुवर्णमणिमुक्ताढ्ये कुले महति जायते॥
en: He who passes the whole of the month of Chaitra, taking every day one meal only, is born in high family and becomes rich in gold, gems, and pearls.

sa: धर्मं हि श्रेय इत्याहुरिति धर्मविदो जनाः। दशाचार्यानुपाध्याय उपाध्यायान् पिता दश॥
en: Persons conversant with the efficacy of righteousness hold that virtue is the highest good. The Upadhyaya is superior to even ten Acharyyas. The father is equal to ten Upadhyayas.

sa: एकलव्यसुतश्चैनं युद्धेन जगृहे तदा। तत्र चक्रे निषादैः स संग्राम लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: The son of Ekalavya received Arjuna in battle! The encounter took place between the Kuru hero and the Nishadas was so furious as to make the hairs stand erect.

sa: इतो दत्तेन जीवन्ति देवताः पितरस्तथा। ते प्रीताः प्रीणयन्तेनमायुषा यशसा धनैः॥
en: Indeed, the celestials and the departed, Manes derive their sustenance from such offerings. Pleased with such offerings they please the offerer in return with longevity and fame and riches.

sa: यत् किंचित् पुरुषः पापं कुरुते वृत्तिकर्शितः। अपि गोचर्ममात्रेण भूमिदानेन पूयते॥
en: Whatever sins a man commits from want of the means of livelihood, are all washed off by gift of only so much earth as is covered by a cowhide.

sa: गुरुमभ्यर्च्य वर्धन्ते आयुषा यशसा श्रिया॥ वृद्धान् नाभिभवेज्जातु न चैतान् प्रेषयेदिति।
en: By adoring his preceptor, one increases the period of his life as also his fame and prosperity. One should never censure the old, •nor send them on any business.

sa: भीष्म उवाच रजसा तमसा चैव समवस्तीर्णचेतसः। नरकं प्रतिपद्यन्ते धर्मविद्वेषिणो जनाः॥
en: Bhishma said Those men who hate virtue are said to have their hearts possessed by the qualities of passion and darkness. Such men have always to go to Hell.

sa: स्थावरं जङ्गमं चैव बहुरूपस्ततः स्मृतः। विश्वे देवाश्च यत्तस्मिन् विश्वरूपस्ततः स्मृतः॥
en: He is mobile and immobilc. For this he is called Vahurupa. Thc celestials called Vishvedevas live in his body. Ile is, for this, called Vishvarupa having an universal form.

sa: कामार्थो पृष्ठतः कृत्वा लोभमोहानुसारिणौ। धर्म इत्येव सम्बुद्धास्तानुपास्व च पृच्छ च॥
en: Disregarding both Pleasure and Profit which always follow cupidity and cherishing the condition that only virtues should be sought, do you, O Yudhishthira, wait upon and ask those persons.

sa: तत्राहं दानवान् हत्वा सुबहून् देवकण्टकान्॥ कुशस्थली करिष्यामि निवेशं द्वारकां पुरीम्।
en: There, after killing numberless Danavas that will be as thorns in the side of the gods, I shali take up my residence in Kushasthali at the city of Dwaraka.

sa: ते ते राक्षसास्तथा राजन् भगवन्तमथाब्रुवन्। असौ वैश्रवणो राजा स्वयमायाति तेऽन्तिकम्॥
en: Requested by him to do this, those Rakshasas, O king, said to him king Vaishravana, without waiting for the news, is coming of his own accord to your presence.

sa: संवत्सरमुषित्वाण्डे निष्क्रम्य च महामुनिः। संदधे स महीं कृत्स्नां दिवमूर्ध्वं प्रजापतिः॥
en: Having lived for one whole year within that egg, the great ascetic Brahman, called also Prajapati came out of it and created the whole Earth, and the Heaven above.

sa: निश्चितार्थाश्च ते सर्वे संत्यजन्तः स्वमात्मजम्। निराशा जीविते तस्य मार्गमावृत्य धिष्ठिताः॥
en: Firmly assured, and giving up all hopes of restoring the dead to life, they cast off that offspring of their family and prepared to turn back from that spot.

sa: स तथा निर्गतान् दृष्ट्वा शकुन्तान् नियतव्रतः। सम्भावितात्मा सम्भाव्य भृशं प्रीतमनाऽभवत्॥
en: Ever observing vows, the great ascetic, seeing the birds thus leave him. After having been brought up on his head, thought highly of himself, and became filled with joy.

sa: ऋषिरुवाच मनसोऽप्रतिकूलानि प्रेत्य चेह च वाञ्छसि। भूतानां प्रतिकूलेभ्यो निवर्तस्व यतेन्द्रियः॥
en: see If you seek both here and hereafter what is agreeable to your mind, do you then, with controlled senses, abstain from doing what is disagreeable to all creatures.

sa: नैते कृतयुगे तात चरन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम्। त्रेताप्रभृति वर्धन्ते ते जना भरतर्षभ॥
en: In the Krita cycle, O son, they did not live on Earth. It is from the Treta that they sprang and began to multiply, O chief of Bharata's race.

sa: पृथिव्यामन्तरिक्षे च यत्र संवान्ति वायवः। सप्तैते वायुमार्गा वै तान् निबोधानुपूर्वशः।॥
en: The winds blow, on the Earth's surface and in the sky. There are seven courses in which they blow. Listen to me as I describe them one after another.

sa: यथार्णवगता नद्यो व्यक्तीर्जहति नाम च। नदाश्च ता नियच्छन्ति तादृशः सत्त्वसंक्षयः॥
en: As small rivers falling into larger ones lose their forms and names, and the larger ones falling into the ocean lose their forms and names too, similarly called Liberation.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच सांख्यदर्शनमेतावदुक्तं ते नृपसत्तम। विद्याविद्ये त्विदानी मे त्वं निबोधानुपूर्वशः॥
en: I have thus described you the Sankhya Philosophy. Listen now to me as I tell you what is Vidya (Knowledge) and what is Avidya (Nescience), one after the other.

sa: यावद्धि प्रलयस्तात सूक्ष्मेणाष्टगुणेन ह। योगेन लोकान् विचरन् सुखं संन्यस्य चानघ।॥
en: When the gross body is destroyed, Yogins, gifted with subtile bodies possessed of the eight Yoga powers wander over the universe, enjoying all sorts of happiness, O sinless one.

sa: एतावदेतद् विज्ञानमेतदस्ति च नास्ति च। तृष्णाबद्धं जगत् सर्वं चक्रवत् परिवर्तते।॥
en: The knowledge of this world is this: (Persons who have overcome ignorance think that) it does not exist. The whole universe, feltered by desire, is revolving like a wheel.

sa: शुचिं देशमनड्वाहं देवगोष्ठं चतुष्पथम्। ब्राह्मणं धार्मिकं चैन्य नित्यं कुर्यात् प्रदाक्षणम्॥
en: One should every day go round a sacred place, a bull, a sacred image, a cowpen, the crossing point of four roads, a pious Brahmana, and a sacred tree.

sa: पृथक् संवत्सराग्राणि प्रवक्ष्याम्यनुपूर्वशः। कृते त्रेतायुगे चैव द्वापरे च कलौ तथा॥
en: I shall, in their order, tell you the number of years, that are for different purposes calculated differently, in the Krita, the Treta, the Dvapara, and the Kali Yugas.

sa: ऊर्ध्वं चैकोनविंशत्या कालो नामापरो गुणः। इतीमं विद्धि विंशत्या भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययम्॥
en: Beyond the nineteenth principle is another, viz., Time, called the twentieth. Know that the births and deaths of all creatures are owing to the action of this twentieth principle.

sa: ततस्तस्याभवच्चिन्ता कुत्र वासो भवेदिति। अथ द्वारं समभितो गत्वा स्थित्वा ततोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing these beautiful sights all around, the Rishi began to think of where he would take shelter. Proceeding then to the gate of the palace, he uttered these words:

sa: न कामाननुरुद्धयेत दुःखं कामेषु वै रतिः। प्राप्यार्थमुपयुञ्जीत धर्मं कामान् विसर्जयेत्॥
en: One should not entertain desire. Attachment to desire brings on sorrow. When riches have been acquired one should devote it to virtuous purposes. One should even then relinquish desire.

sa: स्तदा प्रतीतान् प्रशशंस वीर्यवान्। पुनश्च पप्रच्छ सरिद्वरासुतं ततः परं धर्ममहीनचेतसम्॥
en: The great and highly energetic son of Dharma, in return, praised his auditors; and more the king addressed Bhishma, possessed of a high soul, for enquiring about duties. once

sa: वेददृष्टेन विधिना वैष्णवं क्रतुमाहरन्। तस्मिन् सत्रे सदा ब्रह्मा स्वयं भागमकल्पयत्॥
en: They immediately made arrangements for a sacrifice in honour of Vishnu according to the Vedic ordinances. In that sacrifice, Brahman himself assigned a portion of the offerings to Vishnu.

sa: धुन्धुमारश्च राजर्षिः सत्रेष्वेव जरां गतः। प्रीतिदायं परित्यज्य सुष्वाप स गिरिव्रजे॥
en: The royal sage Dhundhumara was possessed by decrepitude even while engaged in celebrating his sacrifices, and foregoing all the merits thereof the merits thereof he fell asleep at Girivraja.

sa: ब्राह्मणो मध्यदेशीयः कश्चिद् वै ब्रह्मवर्जितः। ग्रामं वृद्धियुतं वीक्ष्य प्राविशद भैक्ष्यकासया॥
en: There was a certain Brahmana of the middle country. He had no Vedic learning. (One day), seeing a prosperous village, the man entered it from desire of getting alms.

sa: ऋषयस्ते महाभागाः प्रजास्वेव हि जाजले। भ्रूणहं नहुषं त्वाहुन ते होध्यामहे हविः॥ इत्युक्त्वा ते महात्मानः सर्वे तत्त्वार्थदर्शिनः। ऋषयो यतयः शान्तास्तपसा प्रत्यवेदयन्॥
en: Thus, O Jajali, did those highly blessed Rishis cast that sin of all living creatures and addressing Nuhusha who had committed foeticide, said,-We shall not be able to pour libations in your sacrifice! Thus said those great Rishis and Yatis conversant with truth, having learnt by their ascetic power that king Nahusha had not committed the sin intentionally.

sa: सर्वभूतात्मभूतो हि वासुदेवो महाबलः। पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्॥ ते समेता महात्मानः शरीरमिति संज्ञितम्। तदा विशति यो ब्रह्मन्नदृश्यो लघुविक्रमः॥ उत्पन्न एव भवति शरीरं चेष्टयन् प्रभुः। न विना धातुसंघातं शरीरं भवति क्वचित्॥
en: Endued with great power, Vasudeva is the Soul of all creatures. Earth, Wind, Ether, Water, and Fire forming fifth, are primal clephants of great power. Mingling together they form the body. Possessed of subtile prowess and invisible to all eyes, O Brahmana, the powerful Vasudeva then enter that combination of the five principal elements called body. Such entrance is called his birth, and taking birth He makes the body move about and act. Without a combination of the five principal elements, 110 body can ever be formed.

sa: अतिथिं समनुप्राप्तमभिजानन्तु येऽत्र वै। अथ कन्याः परिवृता गृहात् तस्माद् विनिर्गताः॥
en: Let those that live here know that a guest has come. Hearing the voice of the Rishi, a number of maidens came out in a body from that palace.

sa: दातव्यमित्ययं धर्म उक्तो भूतहिते रतैः। तं मन्यन्ते धनयुताः कृपणैः सम्प्रवर्तितम्॥
en: Persons who do good to all creatures have said that charity is another high duty. The rich people think that this duty has been laid down by the poor.

sa: कृती सर्वत्र लभते प्रतिष्ठां भाग्यसंयुताम्। अकृती लभते भ्रष्टः क्षते क्षारावसेचनम्॥
en: A man of (good) act gains merits with good fortune, while and idler loses his estate, and reaps evil like the infusion of alkaline matter injected into a wound.

sa: भो भो ब्रह्मर्षिवासिष्ठ ब्रह्मघोषो न वर्तते। एको ध्यानपरस्तूष्णीं किमास्से चिन्तयन्निव।॥
en: Narada said O twice-born Rishi of Vashistha's family, why are Vedic sounds silent now? Why are you sitting silent and alone, engaged in meditation like one engrossed in thought?

sa: जिज्ञासेयं प्रयुक्ता मे स्थिरीकर्तुं तवानघ। अव्युत्थानेन ते लोका जिताः सत्यपराक्रम॥
en: This trial was converted by me, O sinless one, for examining you aright, O you of infallible prowess, you have conquered all the worlds by the strength of mind.

sa: व्यास उवाच अथ ज्ञानप्लवं धीरो गृहीत्वा शान्तिमात्मनः! उन्मजंश्च निमश्च ज्ञानमेवाभिसंश्रयेत्॥
en: Vyasa said Carried up and down in life's ocean, he that is capable of meditation catches the raft of Knowledge, and for achieving his Liberation adheres to Knowledge itself.

sa: न चैषां चोदना काचिदस्तीत्येष विनिश्चयः। एकैकस्येह विज्ञानं नास्त्यात्मनि तथा परे॥
en: It is again well known that nobody asks any of these, saying, who are you? Each of them also has no knowledge either of itself or of the others.

sa: स्रवन्ति न निवर्तन्ते स्रोतांसि सरितामिव। आयुरादाय मर्त्यानां राज्यहानि पुनः पुनः॥
en: Days and nights are continually running, carrying away in their current the periods of life of all human beings. Like currents of rivers, these flow ceaselessly without ever returning.

sa: नास्ति नासीन्नाभविष्यद् भूतं कामात्मकात् परम्। एतत् सारं महाराज धर्मार्थावत्र संस्थितौ॥
en: A man who has no Desire never is, was, or will be, seen in this world. This, O king, is the truth. Both Virtue and Wealth depend upon Desire.

sa: एते शकुन्ता बहवः समन्ताद् विचरन्ति ह। तवोत्तमाङ्गे सम्भूताः श्येनाश्चान्याश्च जायतः॥
en: See, many birds are roving in the sky! Amongst them are those who were brought up on your head, as also many hawks and many others of different kinds.

sa: तस्मिन्नेवाथ काले तु तीर्थयात्रामुपागतः। इक्ष्वाकुरगमत् तत्र समेता यत्र ते विभो॥
en: Just at that time, O monarch, (king) Ikshvaku, who had started on a pilgrimage to holy waters and shrines, came there where those gods had been assembled together. are

sa: साञ्जलिः प्रणतिं कृत्वा वाक्यमाह वनस्पतिम्॥ शरणं यामि यान्यस्मिन् दैवतानि वनस्पतौ।
en: Bowing down to it with clasped hands, he addressed that king of the forest, saying,-I seek refuge with all the gods who have this tree for their resting place.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अथ तत्र महार्चिष्माननलो वातसारथिः। तस्याविदूरे रक्षार्थ खगेन्द्रेण कृतोऽभवत्॥
en: Bhishma said There, under that banian tree for the protection of his guest, the prince of birds had lighted and kept up a fire with high and burning flames.

sa: आशिषस्ता भजन्त्येनं परुषं प्राह यत् पिता। निष्कृतिः सर्वपापानां पिता यच्चाभिनन्दति॥
en: Whatever words are spoken by the father, become blessings that attach to the son. The words of joy that the father utters purify the son of all his sins.

sa: त्वचा स्पर्शयते स्पर्श बुद्धिर्विक्रियतेऽसकृत्। येन प्रार्थयते किञ्चित् तदा भवति तन्मनः॥
en: One acquires perception of touch by the skin that covers the body. That which is called the Intelligence undergoes changes. When the Intelligence desires anything it is called Mind.

sa: विशुद्धधर्मा शुद्धेन बुद्धेन च स बुद्धिमान्। विमुक्तधर्मा मुक्तेन समेत्य पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Uniting with what is Pure, he becomes Pure. Uniting with the Intelligent, he becomes Intelligent. By uniting, O foremost of men, with one that is Liberate he becomes Liberated.

sa: अहं राजा च विप्रेन्द्र पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम्। मत्कृतस्योपदेशस्य त्वयावाऽऽप्तमिदं फलम्॥
en: I have taken birth as a king, O foremost of Brahinanas. See the changes that Time encompasses. You have reaped this fruit on account of your having instructed me.

sa: धर्मस्य ह्रियमाणस्य लोभग्रस्तैर्दुरात्मभिः। या या विक्रियते संस्था ततः सापि प्रपद्यते॥
en: When wicked men under the influence of covetousness practise for the inere show of righteousness, the result is that the desecrations committed by them, soon become current among men.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतदुक्तं परं ब्रह्म यस्मान्नावर्तते पुनः। पञ्चविंशो महाराज परमर्षिनिदर्शनात्॥
en: Bhishma said I have thus told you of high Brahma, just as the great Rishi had said, by attaining to which the Twenty-fifth (Individual Soul) has never to return.

sa: पुत्रा दारास्तथैवात्मा कोशो मित्राणि संचयाः। परैः साधारणा ह्येते तैस्तैरेवास्य हेतुभिः॥१५०॥
en: Like kings others also have sons and wives and their own selves and treasuries and friends and stores. In these respects the king does not differ from other men.

sa: तत्र देवगणाः साध्या महाभूता महाबलाः। तेषामप्यभवत् पुत्रः समानो नाम दुर्जयः॥
en: The body has the senses. The senses are ruled over by the Sadhyas and many great beings of great strength. These gave birth to an invincible son named Samana.

sa: न च मृत्योर्न चाधर्मान्न लोभान्न कुतश्चन) पीतामृतस्येवात्यन्तमिह वामुत्र च भयम्॥
en: Like one that has drunk nectar I have no fear, either in this world or in the next, of death, or sin, or cupidity, or anything of that sort.

sa: प्रायेण च गृहस्थस्य ममत्वं नाम जायते। सङ्गागतं नरश्रेष्ठ भावै राजसतामसैः॥
en: It is generally seen, O king. that on account of sentiments fraught with Darkness and Ignorance, the senses of mine begotten by attachment, originates in the heart of householder.

sa: उत्सवादुत्सवं यान्ति स्वर्गात स्वर्ग सुखात् सुखम्। श्रद्दधानाश्च दान्ताश्च धनस्था: शुभकारिणः॥
en: Possessed of affluence, persons having faith, who are self-controlled, and who are devoted to righteous deeds, go from joy to joy, from heaven to heaven, from happiness to happiness.

sa: नानाशास्त्रेषु निष्पन्नं योगेष्विदमुदाहृतम्। परं योगस्य यत् कृत्यं निश्चितं तद् द्विजातिषु॥
en: All this that I have told you has been stated in the various treatises on Yoga. The highest fruits of Yoga are seen in persons of the twiceborn order.

sa: न संकरेण द्रविणं प्रचिन्वीयाद् विचक्षणः। धर्मार्थं न्यायमुत्सृज्य न तत् कल्याणमुच्यते॥
en: The man endued with wisdom would not seek riches for the performance of religions rites by unfair and immoral ways. Wealth aquired by such means can never yield benefits.

sa: सुप्रभां नाम वै नाम्ना रूपेणाप्रतिमां भुवि। गुणप्रभावशीलेन चारित्रेण च शोभनाम्॥
en: The name by which the lady was known was Suprabha. In beauty she was peerless on Earth. In virtues dignity, conduct, and manners, she was superior to all girls.

sa: विषयेभ्यो नमस्कुर्याद् विषयान्न च भावयेत्। साम्यमुत्पाद्य मनसा मनस्येव मनो दधत्॥
en: He should, bowing to all earthly matters, take leave of them and never think of them. He should, acquiring equanimity of, mind, fix his mind on the mind itself.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। येन वृत्तेन धर्मज्ञः स जगाम महत्सुखम्॥
en: “Regarding it is cited the following old narrative of the particular conduct by which that king, a master of all courses of conduct, succeeded in acquiring the highest happiness.

sa: यन्मया वार्यमाणस्त्वं नावगच्छसि दुर्मते। पश्चादस्य फलं प्राप्य ज्ञास्यसे निरयं गतः॥
en: As, O wicked-minded one, you desistest not, albeit forbidden by me, you shall, afterwards attaining the fruit of this, and repairing to hell, know (the fate that follow there).

sa: तन्मह्यं रोचते संधिः सह रामेण रावण। यदर्थमभियुक्तोऽसि सीता तस्मै प्रदीयताम्॥
en: Therefore, O Rāvana, peace with Rāma is what commends itself to me; and do you render to him that for which you have been invaded (by him), viz., Sītā.

sa: स्मृतिर्वा नास्ति ते मन्ये व्यक्तं वा यमसादनम्। गन्तुमिच्छसि यन्मां त्वमाधर्षयितुमिच्छसि॥
en: Either this has escaped your memory or I fancy, you plainly act to go to the abode of Yama, inasmuch as you have set your heart on beating me.

sa: संपतन्त्यथ भूतानि दृश्यन्ते च यथाक्रमम्। गृध्रचक्रं महच्चात्र प्रज्वालोदारिभिर्मुखैः॥ रक्षोगणस्योपरिष्टात्परिभ्रमति कालवत्।
en: Creatures were one after another seen to drop down; and mighty swarms of vultures, with mouths belching forth flames, began to wheel over the Raksasa, like to Kala himself.

sa: अहो स्वप्नस्य सुखता याहमेव चिराहता। प्रेषितं नाम पश्यामि राघवेण वनौकसम्॥
en: Alas! this dream has afforded me immense pleasure since, I, who have been separated from my lord for so long a time, have beheld this monkey sent by Rāghava.

sa: बाष्पपूर्णमुखी मन्दं चक्षुषी परिमार्जती। लक्षिताहं त्वया नाथ वायसेन प्रकोपिता ॥
en: Now I, having my countenance bathed in tears, gently rubbed my eyes. And I was seen by you, O my lord, in that wise, greatly enraged with the crow.

sa: तदान्तरिक्षे त्रिदशोत्तमानां वनौकसां चैव महाप्रणादः।। बभूव तस्मिनिहतेऽग्र्यवीर्ये नरान्तके वालिसुतेन संख्ये॥
en: On Narāntaka of exceeding prowess having been slain by Vali's son in battle, there arose a tremendous uproar in the firmament from the wood-rangers and the foremost of celestials.

sa: शृणोति य इदं काव्यं पुरा वाल्मीकिना कृतम्। श्रद्दधानो जितक्रोधो दुर्गाण्यतितरत्यसौ॥
en: He, who with devotion and having his anger subdued, shall hear the story of this epic written by Vālmīki in the days of yore shall get over all troubles.

sa: निरनुक्रोशता चेयं यादृशी ते निशाचर। स्वजनेन त्वया शक्यं पौरुषं रावणानुज॥
en: O night-ranger, such is this your relentlessness, that, O Ravana's younger brother, you being a kindred, are capable of displaying your manliness (as no other person can do so).

sa: ब्रूहि गच्छ दशग्रीवं पुरी राज्यं च यन्मम। तवाप्येतन्महाबाहो भुक्ष्व राज्यमकण्टकम्॥
en: Go and tell the Ten-necked one, as this city and this kingdom are mine, so they are your, O mighty-armed one. Do you enjoy this kingdom without a foe.

sa: समग्रं सागरं तीण दुस्तरं वानरं बलम्। अभूतपूर्व रामेण सागरे सेतुबन्धनम्॥
en: The crossing the entire ocean incapable of being crossed, by the monkey-forces, and the building over the sea of the bridge by Rāma, all this had never happened before.

sa: अस्या नूनं पुनर्लाभाद् राघवः प्रीतिमेष्यति। राजा राज्यपरिभ्रष्टः पुनः प्राप्येव मेदिनीम्॥
en: As a monarch who had lost his kingdom, is greatly delighted when he regain it, forsooth shall Rāghava, in like manner, be pleased when he shall come by her.

sa: ऋषभो दक्षिणातूर्णं समुद्राज्जलमानयत्॥ रक्तचन्दनकपूरैः संवृतं काञ्चनं घटम्। गवयः पश्चिमातोयमाजहार महार्णवात्॥
en: Rşabha speedily brought water from the southern Ocean. Gavaya brought from the great Western Ocean in that golden jar, water perfumed with the fragrance of red sandal and camphor.

sa: ततः स रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा रक्षांसि तान्याह महाबलानि। द्वारेषु चर्यागृहगोपुरेषु सुनिर्वृतास्तिष्ठत निर्विशङ्काः॥
en: Then that high-souled lord of Rākşasas addressed that mighty host, saying, "Do you casting off fear stay at ease, at the gateways, high ways, and the edifices (in Lankā).

sa: अथवा त्वरसे मतुं गच्छ दक्षिणसागरम्। वालिनं द्रक्ष्यसे तत्र भूमिष्ठमिव पावकम्॥
en: Or if you do wish to meet with death do you speedily repair to the southern ocean and you shall behold there Vali like to fire placed on earth.

sa: न विनश्येत् कथं कार्यं रामस्य विदितात्मनः। एकामेकस्तु पश्येयं रहिते जनकात्मजाम्॥
en: How can the work of Rāma cognizant of self (be so managed that it) may not be brought to naught? How can I see Janaka's daughter singly in secret?

sa: वीरबाहुः सुबाहुश्च नलश्च पनसस्तथा। निपीड्योपनिविष्टास्ते प्राकारं हरियूथपाः।। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चक्रुः स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम्॥
en: And Virabăhu, Subāhu, Nala and Panasaleader of monkeys-breaking (a portion of) the wall, took up their post there. In the meantime, (they) arranged the forces in order of battle.

sa: इममाएं स्तवं दिव्यमितिहासं पुरातनम्। ये नराः कीर्तयिष्यन्ति नास्ति तेषां पराभवः॥
en: Those persons shall never be unsuccessful both in this world and the next who shall chant this theme-excellent, instinct with the knowledge of Brahmă and describing the old history.

sa: ऋष्यमूके वसंश्चैव दीनो भग्नमनोरथः। सुग्रीवः प्रापितो राज्यं पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम् ॥
en: By him Sugriva, poorly and living in the mount Rșyamūka, having all his desires frustrated, was placed on the throne-that too even was the sufficient proof of his power.

sa: पफाल च तदाक्रान्तं दशग्रीवस्य पश्यतः। पुरा हिमवतः शृङ्गं वज्रेणेव विदारितम्॥
en: Thereat, as formerly the summit of the Himavān had been cleft by the thunder bold, the palace, thus assailed, was split in the very presence of the Ten-necked one.

sa: तेषां प्रभावो दुर्धर्षः प्रदीप्त इव पावकः। तपसा भावितात्मानो धर्मस्यानुग्रहे रताः॥
en: The power of these possessed of souls sanctified through asceticism, and ever engaged in invoking the aid of righteousness, is incapable of being resisted and is like flaming fire.

sa: अयं च राजा व्यसनाभिभूतो मित्रैरमित्रप्रतिमैर्भवद्भिः। अन्वास्यते राक्षसनाशनार्थे तीक्ष्णः प्रकृत्या ह्यसमीक्ष्यकारी॥
en: The king, naturally of fierce temper and thoughtless, through the instrumentality of you who appearing to be his friends are in reality his foes, seek to destroy the Rākşasas.

sa: रुधिरोक्षितगात्रस्य बभूव पतितं द्विधा। तच्च तस्य परीताक्षं शुभं खङ्गहतं शिरः॥
en: The graceful head of the one having his body covered with blood, cut off by the sword, falling to the ground with its eyes rolling, was severed in twain.

sa: प्राकारैर्विविधाकारैः शोभिताश्च शिलातलैः। तत्रैव च वनोद्देशे वैदूर्यमणिसंनिभैः॥ शाद्वलैः परमोपेतां पुष्पितदुमकाननाम्।
en: And the forest was encompassed by stone walls and in the-irtside were dwelling many a Sárdula bird resembling Vaiduryas. All the trees in the forest were filled with flowers.

sa: न ते ददृशिरे रामं दहन्तमपि वाहिनीम्। मोहिताः परमात्रेण गान्धर्वेण महात्मना॥
en: They were all bewildered by the huge Gandharva weapon discharged by the high souled Rama and so they could not see Rama, whose was thus burning down their force.

sa: हिरण्यकशिपोर्मृत्युरन्येषां च सुरद्विषाम्। नमुचिः कालनेमिश्च संहादो वीरसत्तमः॥ राधेयो बहुमायी च लोकपालोऽथ धार्मिकः। यमलार्जुनौ च हार्दिक्यः शुम्भश्चैव निशुम्भकः।।३५ असुरा दानवाश्चैव सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः। सर्वे समरमासाद्य न श्रूयन्तेऽपराजिताः॥ सर्वैः क्रतुशतैरिष्टं सर्वे मायाविदस्तथा। सर्वे सर्वास्त्रकुशलाः सर्वे शत्रुभयंकराः॥ नारायणेन निहताः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। एतज्ज्ञात्वा तु सर्वेषां क्षमं कर्तुमिहार्हथ। दुःखं नारायणं जेतुं यो नो हन्तुमिहेच्छति॥
en: Hiranyakaśipu has met with death (at the hands of Hari), as also other enemies of the immortals. And Namuci and Kālanemi, and that foremost of heroes, Sanhrada and Rādheya, and Bahumāyī, and the virtuous Lokapāla, and Yamala, and Arjuna, and Hardikya, and Sumbha and Niśumbhaka, Asuras and Dānavas endowed with strength and possessed of terrific prowess all these, who having come to the field, had never been heard of as worsted, who had performed hundreds of sacrifices, who had been well skilled in illusion, who had been versed in every branch of knowledge, and who were the terrors of their foes have by hundreds and by thousands been destroyed by Narayana. Learning this, it behove you to do what would conduce to the behoof of all. It is a sore task to defeat Narayana, who wish to slay us.

sa: ब्रह्माणं सा नमस्कृत्य प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्। किं कार्यं मयि भूतेश येनास्म्योह निर्मिता॥
en: She bowed down to Brahma and spoke to him with joined hands, “O lord of creatures, what task am I to accomplish and for what purpose am I created?"

sa: दिव्यास्त्राणि महातेजा यो धारयति बुद्धिमान्। साङ्गांश्च चतुरो वेदांस्तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of that powerful hero of great intelligence who is a master of all the celestial weapons as also of the four Vedas with all their auxiliaries.

sa: रामस्य दयितं शिष्यं जामदग्न्यस्य पाण्डव। आधारं सर्वविद्यानां तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of him, O son of Pandu, who is the favourite disciple of Rama the son of Jamadagni, and who is the master of all the sciences.

sa: असाधुः साधुतामेति साधुर्भवति दारुणः। अरिश्च मित्रं भवति मित्रं चापि प्रदुष्यति॥
en: A wicked man puts on the appearance of honesty, and he who is honest becomes otherwise. An enemy may become a friend, and a friend may become an enemy.

sa: न कुत्सयाम्यहं किंचिन्न गर्हे बलवत्तरम्। कृतमन्वेति कर्तारं पुरा कर्म द्विजोत्तम॥
en: I never speak evil of anything; neither I hate anything, however great. O best of the twiceborn persons, the actions done in the past existence always follow the doer.

sa: अभिवाद्य ततः पादौ मातापित्रोविशाम्पते।॥ भीष्मद्रोणकृपादीनां विदुरस्य च धीमतः। अभिवादितः कनीयोभिर्धातृभिर्धातनन्दनः॥
en: O king, then worshipping the feet of his father and mother and others headed by Bhishma, Drona and the wise Vidura and being worshipped also by his younger brothers.

sa: चक्षुर्दद्यान्मनो दद्याद् वाचं दद्यात् सुभाषिताम्। उत्थाय चासनं दद्यादेषधर्मः सनातनः। प्रत्युत्थायाभिगमनं कुर्यात्र्यायेन चार्चनम्॥ अग्निहोत्रमनड्वांश्च ज्ञातयोऽतिथिबान्धवाः। पुत्रा दाराश्च भृत्याश्च निर्दहेयुरपूजिताः॥ आत्मार्थं पाचयेन्नान्नं न वृथा घातयेत् पशून्। न च तत् स्वयमश्नीयाद् विधिवद् यन्न निर्वपेत्॥
en: Pleasant looks, cheerful heart and sweet words are due to a guest. Rising up, the host should advance towards the guest; he should offer him a seat and duly worship him. This is the eternal Dharma. They who do not perform Agnihotra, they who do not wait upon bulls and cherish their kinsmen, guest, friends, sons, wives and servants, for such negligence are consumed with sin. None should cook his food for himself, none should kill any animal for nothing. Non should eat that food which is not duly dedicated.

sa: सम्यक्संकल्पसंबन्धात् सम्यक् चेन्द्रियनिग्रहात् सम्यग्व्रतविशेषाच्च सम्यक च गुरुसेवनात्॥ सम्यगाहारयोगाच्च सम्यक् चाध्ययनागमात्। सम्यक्कर्मोपसंन्यासात् सम्यक्चित्तनिरोधनात्॥ एवं कर्माणि कुर्वन्ति संसारविजिगीषवः। रागद्वेषविनिर्मुक्ता ऐश्वर्यं देवता गताः॥
en: Those, who wish to subdue the world for the purposes of salvation, should always act by fully renouncing all motives and by subduing their senses, rigidly observing vows, devotedly serving their preceptors, austerely regulating their food, diligently studying the Vedas, renouncing action as mean and restraining their heart. By renouncing desire and aversions, the celestials have obtained prosperity.

sa: शक्र उवाच खरयोनिमनुप्राप्तस्तुषभक्षोऽसि दानव। इयं ते योनिरधमा शोचस्याहो न शोचसि॥
en: 'You are now, O Danava, born as an ass living on chaff. This your birth is certainly a low one. Do you or do you not grieve for it?

sa: हतो द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च हतः शल्यः प्रतापवान्। वैरस्त चादिकर्ताऽसौ शकुनिनिहतो रणे॥
en: Drona also has been killed. Karna has been killed. Shalya of great valour has been killed. Yonder Shakuni also, the root of these enunities, has been killed in battle.

sa: संविभागं दमं शौचं सौहदं च व्यपाश्रिताः। मम वैश्याः स्वकर्मस्था मामकान्तरमाविशः॥
en: They give to their guests what is their due, are self-controlled and pure, and devoted to their relatives and kinsmen. How then have you been to possess my heart?

sa: पश्यतो भीमसेनस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः। ततः किरीटी भीमश्च सहसा संन्यवर्तताम्॥
en: In the very presence of Bhimasena and of the high-souled Partha. (Then) that one who wore a coronet (i.e. Arjuna and Bhimasena, rallying (their troops) all on a sudden.

sa: स तस्तेष्वसनं छित्त्वा फाल्गुनिः सव्यदक्षिणौ। भुजौ शिरश्च स्वक्षिभू क्षितौ क्षिप्रमपातयत्॥
en: But the son of Phalguna cutting off his bow, his right and left arms and his head graced with beautiful eyes and eye-brows, soon felled them on the earth.

sa: विक्रीड्य सुचिरं भीमो राक्षसेन सहानघ। निजघान महावीर्यस्तं तदा निर्बलं बली॥
en: O sinless one, after playing with (the strength of) the Rakshasas for a long time, the powerful and greatly energetic Bhima killed him when he became exhausted and weak.

sa: लोकाः संक्षुभिताः सर्वे व्याकुलं च चराचरम्। समुद्राणां च संक्षोभस्त्रिदशेश प्रकाशते।॥
en: The Celestialss said: "O lord of heaven, all created beings have become agitated; all the mobile and immobile creatures have become restless. The ocean are also in great agitation.

sa: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य देवदूतो यदृच्छया। स्थितो ह्यन्तर्हितो भूत्वा पर्यभाषत वासवम्॥
en: Once on a time a celestial messenger, coming to the court of Indra of his own accord, but remaining invisible, addressed the king of the deities in these words:

sa: कृतातिथ्यस्तु गोविन्दः सर्वान् परिहसन् कुरुन्। आस्ते साम्बन्धिकं कुर्वन् कुरुभिः परिवारितः॥
en: The rites of hospitality being finished, Govinda stayed there (for a short time) surrounded by the Kurus, jesting with them and exchanging words of courtesy according to his relationship.

sa: ततः सम्मन्त्रयामास मन्त्रिभिः स महीपतिः। हिरण्यवर्मा राजेन्द्र पाञ्चाल्यं पार्थिवं प्रति॥
en: Then that ruler of the earth, Hiranyavarman held a consultation with his ministers, O great king (as to the course to be taken) against the king of the Panchalas.

sa: नित्यं प्रमुदिता मूढा दिवि देवगणा इव। अवलेपेन महता परिभूत्या विचेतसः॥
en: Men who have no ideas of right or wrong, who are beside themselves with pride and with success over others, give way to transports of delight like the celestials.

sa: तेषां प्रयतमानानां नादृश्यत महामृगः। अपश्यन्तो मृगं शान्ता दुःखं प्राप्ता मनस्विनः॥
en: When they were thus exerting (their utmost to slay it) that great deer went out of sight. That deer disappearing (from sight) those highsouled ones became fatigued and disappointed.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमाश्वासितो राजा शल्येन भरतर्षभ। पूजयामास विधिवच्छल्यं धर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said The king being thus encouraged by Shalya, O you best of the race of Bharata, that chief among the supporters of virtue did due honours to Shalya.

sa: कर्णं तु शूरं पतितं पृथिव्यां शराचितं शोणितदिग्धगात्रम्। श्छिन्नध्वजेनाथ ययौ रथेन॥
en: Beholding the brave Karna prostrated on earth wounded with shafts and bathed in blood the king of Madras left the battle field on the car deprived of the standard.

sa: स संरब्धः समावृत्य शरं कालान्तकोपमम्। संदधे बलवत् कृष्य घोरं शत्रुनिबर्हणम्॥
en: Filled with great wrath he turned round, and drawing his bow with great strength aimed at me a terrible shaft, resembling death himself and capable of grinding all enemies.

sa: ये तु धर्मानसूयन्ते बुद्धिमोहान्विता नराः। अपथा गच्छतां तेषामनुयाता च पीड्यते॥
en: Those persons, who, being intelligent and full of delusions, hate these virtues, surely tread in the sinful path. The men who follow them fall in the abyss of decay.

sa: पितृतः प्राप्तवान् राज्यं पाण्डुरात्मगुणैः पुरा। त्वमन्धगुणसंयोगात् प्राप्तं राज्यं न लब्धवान्॥
en: Pandu formerly obtained the ancestral kingdom by virtue of his accomplishments. Because you were blind, you did not get the kingdom, though you have every accomplishment to obtain it.

sa: वृष्णीनां प्रवरं वीरं शूरं सर्वधनुष्मताम्। रामेण सममस्त्रेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च॥
en: That foremost hero among the Vrishnis that bravest among all wielders of bow, who is equal to Rama himself in the use of weapons, in glory and in prowess.

sa: तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे पृतनां शिनीनां प्रवरे रथे। भोजानीकं व्यतिक्रान्ते किमकुर्वत कौरवाः।।
en: When that foremost of car-warriors among the Sinis had plunged into my host and when he had passed through the Bhoja division, what, O Sanjaya, did the Kurus do?

sa: ते च प्राप्यैव संग्रामे निर्जिताः सव्यसाचिना। शैनेयन परामृष्टाः किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥
en: Even such troops, encountering Savayasachin in battle, are being vanquished by him; they are also being crushed by the grand son of Sini; what can it be but Destiny?

sa: विदुर उवाच उपमानामिदं राजन् मोक्षविद्भिरुदाहृतम्। सुकृतं विन्दते येन परलोकेषु मानवः॥
en: Vidura said O king, they that are conversant with the religion of Moksha cite this as a simile. Understanding this properly, a person may attain to blissful regions hereafter.

sa: अहिंसादममास्थाय कथं नार्हामि विप्रताम्। दैवं तु कथमेतद् वै यदहं मातृदोषतः॥
en: not How unfortunate I am, O Purandara, that through the sin of my mother I have been reduced to this plight, although I am not unrighteous in my conduct?

sa: तव प्रसादादिच्छेयं सिन्धुराजानमाहवे। निहन्तुं द्विपदां श्रेष्ठ प्रतिज्ञां रक्ष मे प्रभो॥
en: Through your grace, I desire to slay the ruler of the Sindhus in battle, O you foremost as of men. O lord, see that my vow may be fulfiled.

sa: अन्यानपि सृजेयुश्च लोकालोकेश्वरांस्तथा। कथं तेषु न वर्तेरन् सम्यग् ज्ञानात् सुतेजसः॥
en: They are capable of creating other worlds and other Regents of worlds. Why then should not persons gifted with energy and true knowledge treat thein with obcdience and respect?

sa: द्रोणं निवारितं दृष्ट्वा कुमारेण द्विजर्षभम्। सिंहनादरवो ह्यासीत् साधु साध्विति भाषितम्॥
en: When Drona the foremost of the regenerated ones was seen to be held in check by Kumara, there were heard sounds of carcries and exclamations of Excellent, excellent etc.

sa: योऽहं भवन्तं दुःखार्तमुपवासकृशं भृशम्। जिनाहारं क्षितिशयं न विन्दे भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: Alas, I, with all my brothers, was ignorant of yourself having so long been stricken with grief, emaciated with fasts, abstaining from food, and lying on the naked earth.

sa: इमौ तौ परिघप्रख्यौ भुजौ मम दुरासदौ॥ ययोरन्तरमासाद्य धार्तराष्ट्राः क्षयं गताः।
en: These are those two well-developed and round arms of mine, resembling a pair of elephantine trunks. Coming within their clasp, the foolish sons of Dhritarashtra have all been killed.

sa: न चैनमशकं हन्तुं तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्। तस्मिन् प्रतिहते चास्त्रे विस्मयो मे महानभूत्॥
en: (But) it was a wonder (to me) that I could not hurt him (even with that). And when that weapon produced no effect I was lost in great wonder.

sa: एवमेव मनुष्येन्द्र भक्तिमन्तं समाश्रितः। सर्वार्थसिद्धिं लभते शुकं प्राप्य यथा द्रुमः॥
en: Thus, o king, by communion and companionship with the pious, people acquire all the objects of their desire even as the tree did through its companionship with the parrot."

sa: त्वामिन्द्रमाहुस्त्वं रुद्रस्त्वं विष्णुस्त्वं प्रजापतिः। त्वमग्निस्त्वं मनः सूक्ष्म प्रभुस्त्वं ब्रह्म शाश्वतम्॥
en: You are called Indra, you are Vishnu, you are Rudra, (you are) Prajapati, you are fire, you are the subtle mind, you are the lord and the eternal Brahma.

sa: अज्ञानाद् वा भयाद्वापि मयि बाले जनार्दन। न तदद्य पुनर्लभ्यं पाण्डवैर्वृष्णिनन्दन।॥
en: Out of ignorance or fear when I was a child, O Janardana; it is not now to be regained by the sons of Pandu, o delighted of the Vrishinis.

sa: वैश्यास्तु भोज्या विप्राणां क्षत्रियाणां तथैव च। नित्याग्नयो विविक्ताश्च चातुर्मास्यरताश्च ये॥
en: Brahmanas and Kshatriyas can partake of food given by such Vaishyas as serve the sacred fire everyday as are faultless in character and as perform the VOW of Chaturmasya.

sa: ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वाः शाल्वेभ्योऽभ्यागता नृप। आचख्युनिहतं चैव स्वेनामात्येन तं द्विषम्॥
en: Then, O king, it so chanced that all the subjects came from Shalva and informed Dyumatsena of the death of his enemy at the hands of his own minister.

sa: एष हि प्रथमो धर्मः क्षत्रियस्याभिषेचनम्। येन शक्यं महाप्राज्ञ प्रजानां परिपालनम्॥
en: Even this is the first duty of a Ksatriya, viz., getting oneself installed, by means of which, O highly wise one, he can compass the government of the people.

sa: वाताश्चापि प्रवान्त्येते स्पर्शयुक्ताः सुखाः शिवाः। ईदृशो नश्चिरं राजा भवेदिति नरेश्वरः॥
en: The wind is always delightful and wholesome. O king of men, the inhabitants of the city and provinces are all saying "we may have for ever such a king.

sa: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्या न शिष्यन्ति जनाधिप। एकवर्णस्तदा लोको भविष्यति युगक्षये॥
en: O ruler of men, the Brahmanas, the Kshatriyas and the Vaishyas will disappear, leaving no trace of their orders. At this time all men will be of one order.

sa: ईदृशो राजसिंहस्य यज्ञः सर्वगुणान्वितः। संवत्सरमथो साग्रं वर्तते न च हीयते॥
en: And though this sacrifice, gifted with all marks, of Rama, a lion among kings, continued for a year still his accumulated treasure was not exhausted, but rather was increased.

sa: य एव प्रथमः कल्पस्तमेवाभ्याचरन् सह। तेषां नासीद् विधातव्यं प्रायश्चित्तं कदाचन॥
en: On account of their observing unitedly the perfect ordinances of the scriptures without following the rites laid down in the alternative, they were never compelled to perform any expiation.

sa: सस्यानि च न रोक्ष्यन्ति युगान्ते पर्युपस्थिते। अभीक्ष्णं क्रूरवादिन्यः परुषा रुदितप्रियाः॥
en: When this age will come, crops will not grow in (great) abundance. The women will always be very harsh in speech; they will become pitiless and fond of weeping.

sa: तावन्योन्यं और राजन् संछाद्य समवस्थितौ। मुहूर्तं चैव तद् युद्धं समरूपमिवाभवत्॥
en: The battle, O great king, between those two (heroes), who, covering each other (with arrows) stood (face to face) in (that) encounter, went on equally for a moment only.

sa: दिष्ट्या तात मनस्तेऽद्य स्वधर्ममनुवर्तते। आनृशंस्ये च ते दिष्ट्या बुद्धिः सततमच्युत॥
en: Surely it is fortunate, O sire, that your heart today bends towards virtue. It is also fortune that your understanding today inclines towards showing compassion, you of undeteriorating fame.

sa: नृशंसः स मयाऽऽक्रम्य रथ एव निपातितः। तन्मामनिन्द्यं बीभत्सो किमर्थं नाभिनन्दसे॥
en: That ruthless warrior, being assailed by me, has been overthrown and slain by me. O Vibhatsu, why do you not then congratulate myself on whom actually no blame hangs?

sa: समाततेनेष्वसनेन कूजता भृशायतेनामितबाणवर्षिणा। बभूव दुर्धर्षतरः स सात्यकिः शरन्नभोमध्यगतो यथा रविः॥
en: As in autumn the Sun shines brilliantly in the sky, so with his outstretched bow, which was sounding loudly and sending forth arrows unrestrainedly, Satyaki became hard to face.

sa: मावमंस्था वचो मह्यं गुरुस्तव गुरोर्बाहम्। वासुदेवमतं चैव मम चैवार्जुनस्य च॥
en: Do not disregard iny words, for I am superior to all your superiors. Whatever I say to you, know that to be approved of by Vasudeva and by Arjuna.

sa: आत्मोदरकृतेऽप्राज्ञः करोति विघसं बहु। जयोदरं पृथिव्या ते श्रेयो निर्जितया जितम्॥
en: He who is shorn of wisdom seeks much food for his stomach. Govern your stomach first (After conquering the Death, you will acquire what is for your permanent good.

sa: विसर्जिताऽस्मि भीष्मेण धर्मं मां प्रतिपादय। मनसाभिवृतः पूर्वं मया त्वं पार्थिवर्षभ॥
en: I have been dismissed by Bhishma; act righteously towards me for you had before been chosen by me as my husband, O best among the rulers of the earth.

sa: शून्यान् कुर्वन रथापस्थान् मानवै: संस्तरन् महीम्॥५८ प्रानृत्यदिव सम्बाधे चापहस्तो धनंजयः।
en: Emptying the terraces of the cars, Arjuna over-spread the earth with the corpses of men. In that confused encounter Dhananjaya seemed to dance wielding his bow in his hand.

sa: सोऽयोधयत् तदा कर्णं माया लाघवेन च॥ अलक्ष्यमाणानि दिवि शरजालानि चापतन्।
en: Indeed he fought on with Karna, aided by his illusive powers and exhibiting his great agility. Then showers of shafts began to fall from invisible quarters in the skies.

sa: संस्तम्भ राम भद्रं ते मा शुचः पुरुषोत्तम। नेदृशानां मतिर्मन्दा भवत्यकलुषात्मनाम्॥
en: Forsake your grief, O Rāma. May good betide you. Do not grieve O best of men. Even the sinless persons lose their sense when they are afflicted with grief.

sa: तिष्ठेदानी क्व मे जीवन सूतपुत्र गमिष्यसि॥ युद्धश्रद्धामहं तेऽद्य विनेष्यामि रणाजिरे।
en: Wait a little, O son of Suta, whither shall you go with your life, avoiding me? Today I shall remove your itching for fight on the field of battle.

sa: उभयोः पतिते छत्रे तथैव पतितो ध्वजौ॥ उभौ रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गावुभौ च विजयैषिणौ।
en: The umbrellas of both those warriors were felled and their standards were also cut down. Both of them were bespattered with blood and both were desirous of obtaining victory.

sa: ते शच्यर्थं महेन्द्रेण याचितः स परंतपः। अमोघया महाराज शक्त्या परमभीमया॥
en: These two were asked by the great Indra himself for the sake of Sachi, O subduer of foes, in exchange, O great king of greatly terrific strength and infallible.

sa: तस्य तत् प्रथितं चक्रं प्रावर्तत महात्मनः। भास्वरं दिव्यमजितं लोकसंनादनं महत्॥
en: From that day the invincible car of Bharata, like the car of the celestials, with its famous and bright wheels, traversed the whole earth, filling it with its rattle.

sa: सैरभ्युवाच मा सूतपुत्र मुह्यस्व माद्य त्यक्ष्यस्व जीवितम्। जानीहि पञ्चभि।रैर्नित्यं मामभिरक्षिताम्॥
en: Sairandhri said O son of a Suta, do not play the fool and do not throw away your life this very day; know me always protected by five heroes.

sa: क्षीणे मनसि सर्वस्मिन् च जन्मसुखमिष्यते। ज्ञानसम्पन्नसत्त्वानां तत् सुखं विदुषां मतम्॥
en: When everything is immersed in the mind, one no longer regards highly the pleasures of life. Learned men, whose understandings are furnished with knowledge, consider that as true happiness.

sa: बलस्य परिमाणं च द्वारदुर्गक्रियामपि। गुप्तिकर्म च लङ्काया रक्षसा सदनानि च॥ यथासुखं यथावच्च लङ्कायामसि दृष्टवान्। सर्वमाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन सर्वथा कुशलो ह्यसि ॥
en: O monkey, as you have seen personally, I wish to get acquainted with all this. And you have at your leisure duly noticed in Lankā the nur.ber of the army, the inaccessibility (or otherwise) of the gates, the defence of Lankā, and the dwellings of the Rākşasas. Do you faithfully relate this to me, for you are observant.

sa: ऋद्ध्या तु वरुणं देवं स्पर्धमानो युधिष्ठिरः। षडग्निनाथ यज्ञेन सोऽयजद् दक्षिणावता॥
en: Yudhishthira, as if vying with the deity Varuna himself in wealth, commenced the (Rajasuya) sacrifice which was distinguished by large Dakshinas to Brahmanas and emblazoned with the six fires.

sa: हतप्रवीरा स्विस्ता निकृत्ता निशितैः शरैः॥ सूतपुत्रे हते राजन् पुत्रास्ते प्राद्रवंस्ततः।
en: Their foremost of heroes slain, themselves thrown into confusion and cut with keen arrows, your sons, O king, upon the slaughter of the Suta's son, fled away in fear.

sa: न चात्र किंचिज्जेतव्यमजुनात्र प्रदृश्यते। उत्तराः कुरवो ह्येते नात्र युद्धं प्रवर्तते॥
en: O Arjuna, there is nothing to be seen here, there is nothing to be conquered here by you. The Northern Kurus live here, there cannot be any war here.

sa: उषित्वा च वने वासं ब्राह्मणैः संशितव्रतः। फलमूलाशनो दान्तस्तत: स्वर्गमितो गतः॥
en: He lived in the forest with the Brahmanas, becoming self-controlled and living on fruits and roots. Thus patiently bearing privations of all sorts, he at last ascended to heaven.

sa: वाक्यमप्रतिकूलं तु मृदुपूर्वं शुभं हितम्। उपचारेण वक्तव्यो युक्तं च वसुधाधिपः॥
en: It is always proper to speak before monarchs such pleasant and favourable words as are intended for the welfare of the master and are sanctioned by the royal etiquette.

sa: पुरिकायां पुरि पुरा श्रीमत्यां पौरिको नृपः। परहिंसारति: क्रूरो बभूव पुरुषाधमः॥
en: In days of yore, in a wealthy city called Paurika, there was a king named Paurika. That worst of beings was highly truthless and took pleasure in injuring others.

sa: यन्नः प्रव्राजयः सौम्य अजिनैः प्रतिवासितान्। तद् दुःखमतितिक्षाम मा वधिष्म कुरूनिति॥
en: O amiable one, you sent us into exile with raiment's made of deer skin on. This hardship shall we quietly bear so that the Kurus may not be slaughtered.

sa: समर्थ इति संगृह्य स्थापयित्वा परीक्षितः। कृतं च समय भित्त्वा त्वयाहमवमानितः॥
en: Knowing me to be competent you appointed me, and having examined me you had placed me in office. Violating the agreement then made (between us) you have insulted me.

sa: कक्षघ्नः शिशिरघ्नश्च महाकक्षे विलौकसः। न हन्तीत्येवमात्मानं यो रक्षति स जीवति॥
en: 'Neither the consumer of straw and wood, nor the drier of the dews burns the inmates of a hole in the forest. He escapes from death who protects himself.'

sa: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहंकारेण वा पुनः। क्रियते बहुलायासं तद् राजसमुदाहृतम्॥
en: Raja Action is that which is attended with great trouble and which is performed by one who desires for the fruit of action and who is filled with egoism.

sa: मातापित्रोर्वचनकृद्धितः पथ्यश्च यः सुतः। स पुत्रः पुत्रवद् यश्च वर्तते पितृमातृषु॥
en: The son who obeys the commands of his father and mother, who is humble and a wellwisher of his parents and who loves them, is the best of sons.

sa: इत्युक्ता साऽनवद्याङ्गी प्रत्युवाच मुनि तदा। जरत्कारुं जरत्कारुश्चिन्ताशोकपरायणा॥ बाष्पगद्गदया वाचा मुखेन परिशुष्यता। कृताञ्जलिर्वरारोहा पर्यश्रुनयना ततः॥ धैर्यमालम्ब्य वामोरूहृदयेन प्रवेपता। न मामर्हसि धर्मज्ञ परित्यक्तुमनागसम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the beautiful Jaratkaru, was filled with anxiety and sorrow. Her eyes were full of tears, her face was colourless with fear and her voice choked with sobs. She mustered courage, but her voice was trembling. She joined her hands and thus addressed the Rishi Jaratkaru, "O virtuous man, it is not proper for you to leave me.

sa: जज्ञिरे वसवस्त्वष्टौ गङ्गायां शान्तनोः सुताः। वसिष्ठस्य च शापेन नियोगाद्वासवस्य च॥
en: Begot by her husband Shantanu, the eight Vasus were given birth to by Ganga, on account of the curse of Rishi Vasistha and also from the command of Indra.

sa: किमेवं भृशदुःखार्ती रोरूयेतामनाथवत्। ममापि श्रूयतां वाक्यं श्रुत्वा च क्रियतां क्षमम्॥
en: The Daughter said : Why are you so sorrowful? Why are you weeping, as if you have none. Listen to my words and hearing them, do what is proper.

sa: अस्तीत्युक्त्वा गतो यस्मात्पिता गर्भस्थमेव तम्। वनं तस्मादिदं तस्य नामास्तीकेति विश्रुतम्॥
en: He was known by the name of Astika, because his father had gone away to the forest, saying 'Asti' (one is there), when he was in his mother's womb.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच भगदत्तं धनंजयः। अनेनैव कृतं सर्वमनुजानीहि याम्यहम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) thus replied to Bhagadatta. "If you give me your promise to do it, you will have done all that I desire."

sa: न तं पुत्रेष्ववक्षास्ति यानृषीनुक्तवानसि। तेजस्विनो वीर्यवन्तो न तेषां ज्वलनाद् भयम्॥
en: "You need have no anxiety for your children who, as you have assured me, are all greatly effulgent and powerful Rishis. They can have no fear from the fire.

sa: प्रासादै रत्नचित्रैश्च गिरेस्तस्य समन्ततः। स देशः शोभितो राजन् कल्पवृक्षैश्च सर्वशः॥
en: O king, the region around the hill was adorned with many mansions filled with various gems and they appeared as if they are all Kalpavrikshas (trees giving whatever wanted.)

sa: तावन्योन्यं समाश्लिष्य पृष्ट्वा च कुशलं वने। आस्तां प्रियसखायौ तौ नरनारायणावृषी॥
en: They embracing each other, enquire after one another's health. Those two friends, who were none else than the Rishis Nara and Narayana of old, then both sat down together.

sa: सोऽस्मि संशयमापन्नस्त्वयि शान्ते कथं भवेत्। इति ते कारणं तात दुःखस्योक्तमशेषतः॥
en: "If it so happens, what would be the state of our race! For this reason I am melancholy. I have now told you the cause of my sorrow!” are

sa: ततस्तृतीयं हत्वा तं दग्ध्वा कृत्वा च चूर्णशः। प्रायच्छन् ब्राह्मणायैव सुरायामसुरास्तदा।॥
en: They killed him for the third time. And having reduced him to ashes by burning, they mixed those ashes with the wine which they offered to the Brahmana (Shukra).

sa: तस्मिन् काले तु यद् युक्तं धर्मकामार्थसंहितम्। तद् राजा धर्मतश्चक्रे प्रजापालनकीर्तनम्॥
en: Whatever is consistent with Dharma. Artha and Kama continued at that time to be properly performed by king Yudhishthira in the exercise of his duties in protecting his subjects.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा तथोक्ता तथेत्युक्त्वा तेन भ; वराङ्गना। अभिवाद्याभ्यनुज्ञाता प्रदक्षिणमवर्तत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : That best of women, (Kunti), having been thus addressed, said-"Be it so". She then went round him (for seven times) and resolved to do his bidding.

sa: विष्णो समवसन्नानां गिरिदुर्गे सुदारुणे। दिष्ट्या मोक्षाद् यशो दीप्तमाप्तं ते यदुनन्दन॥
en: O Vishnu, O descendant of Yadu, we were languishing in the fearful hill-fort (of Jaransandha); from our good fortune alone, you have rescued us and earned a great renown.

sa: यस्य बाहू समाश्रित्य सुखं सर्वे शयामहे। राज्यं चापहृतं क्षुद्रराजिहीर्षामहे पुनः॥
en: By the strength of whose arms we all sleep in comfort and hope to recovered the kingdom of which we have been deprived by the wretches (Duryodhana and others).

sa: त्रास्यामि त्वां महाबाहो राक्षसात् पुरुषादकात्। वत्स्यावो गिरिदुर्गेषु भर्ता भव ममानघ।॥
en: O mighty armed hero, I shall rescue you from the Rakshasas who eats human flesh. O sinless one, become my husband. we shall live on the breasts of mountains.

sa: समयः क्रियतामेष न शक्यमतिवर्तितम्। सुरकार्यं हि नः कार्यमसुराणां क्षितौ वधः॥
en: Let this agreement be made and let not that agreement be violated. The destruction of the Asuras is the work of the celestials, therefore it is our work also.

sa: राज्यं तावत् पूर्वमेव मया त्यक्तं नराधिपाः। अपत्यहेतोरपि च करिष्येऽद्य विनिश्चयम्॥
en: O chiefs and potentates, I relinquished my right to the throne a few moments before. I shall now settle the doubt that has arisen in respect to my sons.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच गङ्गाद्वारं प्रति महान् बभूवर्षिर्महातपाः। भरद्वाजो महाप्राज्ञः सततं संशितव्रतः॥
en: The Brahmana said : There lived at the source of the Gangas a great Rishi of rigid vows and great wisdom and of severest austerities; his name was Bharadvaja.

sa: सर्वभूतेषु धर्मज्ञ मैत्रो ब्राह्मण सत्यो भवतु कल्याण एष वादो मनीषिणाम्॥
en: O virtuous man, it is said that a Brahmana has always friendly feelings over all creatures. O Rishi of blessedness, let this saying of the learned be made true.

sa: स शाश्वती: समा राजन् प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्। जरामार्छन्महाघोरां नाहुषो रूपनाशिनीम्॥
en: O king, after ruling his subjects with virtue for a long time. The son of Nahusha (Yayati) was attacked by the terrible old age which destroyed his personal beauty.

sa: अतन्द्रितश्च प्रायेण दुर्बलो बलिनं रिपुम्। जयेत् सम्यक् प्रयोगेण नीत्यार्थानात्मनो हितान्॥
en: It is often seen that even weak king may defeat a strong enemy; and he may be come successful in his attempts by his wakefulness and by using policy.

sa: अविचार्य महाराज राजसूये मनः कुरु। सर्वे पृथक् च सह चाब्रुवन्।॥
en: O great king, set your mind to perforin the Rajasuya without any further discussion." Vaishampayana said Thus spoke to the king all his friends and counsellors separately and together.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कुन्तीपुत्रेषु जातेषु धृतराष्ट्रमजेषु च। मद्रराजसुता पाण्डं रहो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : After the birth of sons of Kunti and that of the sons of Dhritarashtra, the daughter of the king of Madra privately spoke to Pandu thus.

sa: श्वश्वास्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा शयाना शयने शुभे। साचन्तयत् तदा भीष्ममन्यांश्च कुरुपुङ्गवान्॥
en: Having heard these words of her motherin-law, the amiable lady, as she lay on her bed in her bed-room, began to think of Bhishma and other great Kuru chiefs.

sa: अंकुरं कृतवांस्तत्र ततः पर्णद्वयान्वितम्। पलाशिनं शाखिनं च तथा विटपिनं पुनः॥
en: He first created the sprout, he then created two leaves in it. He then made the stem, then the branches and then the full-grown tree with leaves and all.

sa: स भुक्त्वा फलमूलं च महर्षि तमुवाच ह। पूर्वा यज्ञविभूतीयं कस्याश्रमसमीपतः।।।।।
en: After eating the fruits and roots he asked the great ascetic Vālmīki saying: “O great ascetic, to whom belong the articles of sacrifice in the east near this hermitage?”

sa: दृष्ट्वैव चारुवदने चन्द्रात् कान्ततरं तव। वदनं पद्मपत्राक्षं मां मन्यातीव मन्मथः॥
en: O lady of beautiful feature, seeing your face which is lovelier than the moon and your eyes like the lotus leaves, I am oppressed by the god of love.

sa: सा त्वं पीनायतश्रोणि मामापनुहि वरानने। त्वदधीना हि मे प्राणाः किन्नरोद्गीतभाषिणि॥१०
en: O lady of faultless features, O lady of tapering things, O lady of sweet voice as that of the Kinnaris, have mercy on me; my life depends on you.

sa: यैन त्वां नाभिजानीमो लोके विख्यातपौरुषम्। वृद्धो भवान्महाभागो यो नः शोच्यान्सुदुःखितान्॥
en: Therefore we cannot know you, although you are known for your greatness all over the world. You are venerable, you are of good fortune, you sorrowfully grieve for us.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच सा भयान्नन्दिनी तेषां बलानां भरतर्षभ। विश्वामित्रभयोद्विग्ना वसिष्ठं समुपागमत्॥
en: The Gandharva said : O best of the Bharata race, being alarmed at the sight of Vishvamitra's troops and being terrified by Vishvamitra himself, Nandini came closer to Vasishtha.

sa: अथ गङ्गा सरिच्छेष्ठा समुपायात् पितामहम्। तस्या वासः समुद्भूतं मारुतेन शशिप्रभम्॥
en: The queen of the rivers, Ganga also came there to pay her adorations to the Grandsire. Her garments, as white as the moon, were blown away by the winds.

sa: उवाच चैनां भगवान्प्रीतोऽस्मि सुभगे तव। यं यं देवं त्वमेतेन मन्त्रेणावाहयिष्यसि॥
en: The illustrious man said, “O fortunate girl, I am much pleased with you. To those of the celestials whom you will call by this Mantra (that I teach you).

sa: तस्यां नद्यां स जनयन्मिथुनं पर्वतः स्वयम्। तस्माद्विमोक्षणात्प्रीता नदी राज्ञे न्यवेदयत्॥
en: From this embrace of the mountain, the river gave birth to a twin, a son and a daughter and the river, grateful to Vasu, gave them both to him.

sa: अमुञ्चन्तं तु पन्थानं तमृषि नृपसत्तमः। जघान कशया मोहात् तदा राक्षसवन्मुनिम्॥
en: Being enraged on seeing the Rishi decline to yield the way to him, that best of kings, acted like a Rakshasa and he struck him violently with his whips.

sa: तत्र तां भैक्ष्यवत्कन्यां प्रादात्तस्मै महात्मने। नागेन्द्रो वासुकिर्ब्रह्मन्न स तां प्रत्यगृह्णत॥
en: O Brahmana, the king of the snakes Vasuki, having gone there, offered the maiden as a gift to that high-souled Rishi. But he did not at once accept her.

sa: सोऽर्जुनोत्यभिविख्यातः पाण्डोः पुत्रः प्रतापवान्। तस्यायं भविता पुत्रो बालो भुवि महारथः॥
en: He will be known on earth as powerful Arjuna, the son of Pandu. My boy will be his son and even in his boyhood will be a great car-warrior.

sa: तेषां ददौ हृषीकेशो जन्यार्थे धनमुत्तमम्। हरणं वै सुभद्राया ज्ञातिदेयं महायशाः॥
en: Then the illustrious Hrishikesha (Krishna) gave much wealth to the bridge groom's party. He gave to the illustrious Subhadra all the bridal presents given to her by her relatives.

sa: पुरा निघन्ति राधेयं भीमचापच्युताः शराः। ते यतध्वं महेष्वासाः सूतपुत्रस्य रक्षणे॥
en: Yonder, the shafts shot from Bhima's bow are piercing Karna (to the quick). O mighty bowmen, do you all now exert vigourously for protecting the son of the charioteer."

sa: संजय उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा द्रोणपुत्रस्तु निधनं पितुराहवे। क्रोधमाहारयत् तीव्र पदाहत इवोरगः॥
en: Sanjaya said we are Then Drona's son, hearing that account of the slaughter of his father in battle, became filled with fury like a snake trembled under ; feet.

sa: पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां तन्मे मर्माणि कृन्तति। मयि जीवति यत् तात: केशग्रहमवाप्तवान्॥
en: Before the eyes of all the troops; this humiliation that he sustained is biting me to the very quick. Whilst I live, my sire was seized by the hair.

sa: रुदन्नातस्तव सुतं कर्णश्चके प्रदक्षिणम्। स तु तं विरथं कृत्वा स्मयन्नत्यन्तवैरिणम्॥
en: Then having made that inveterate enemy of his (Karna) carless, Bhimasena smilingly covered him with numerous arrows and made him look like a Sataghni with numerous pikes on it.

sa: तस्य वेगमसह्य स दृष्ट्वा कर्णस्य पाण्डवः। महतश्च शरौघांस्तान् न्यवारयत वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then beholding the unbearable charge of Karna and the shower of mighty arrows shot by him, Vrikodara flinched not in fear, inasmuch as he was possessed of mighty energy.

sa: शैनेयः सात्यकिः सत्यो मित्राणामभयंकरः। तदिदं ह्येकमेवासीद् द्विधा जातं ममाद्य वै॥
en: Sini's grandson Satyaki, that one of true prowess, that giver of assurances to his friends. My anxiety that was for one only, is now for two, Satyaki and Arjuna.

sa: मे यथा संजय भाषसे। एको वै बहुला: सेनाः प्रामृद्गत् सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: 0 bestower of honour, when your assembled host daily increased in numerical strength before, I thought that another muster like that of your army had never been on earth.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः कर्णो रणे दृष्ट्वा पार्षतं परवीरहा। आजधानोरसि शरैर्दशभिर्मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then that slayer of foes viz., Karna beholding Prisata's son in battle, pierced the him on the breast with ten arrows capable of penetrating to the vitals.

sa: सर्वेषां च पुनश्चैषां सर्वयोगवहो मयः॥ तमाश्रित्य हि ते सर्वे वर्तयन्तेऽकुतोभयाः।
en: Now Maya had became the supporter of them all, who have thus united together. Indeed, all of them having been under his protection (Maya's) lived there with perfect fearlessness.

sa: स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथः शीर्णवर्मा शरार्दितः। अपायासीद् रणात् तूर्णं धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: With his coat of mail cut-off, deprived of his car and afflicted with the arrows of Krigavarma, Yudhishthira the son of Dharma, quickly withdrew from (the field of) battle.

sa: संजय उवाच व्यूहेष्वालोड्यमानेषु पाण्डवानां ततस्ततः। सुदूरमन्वयुः पार्थाः पञ्चालाः सह सोमकैः॥
en: Sanjaya said When the armies of the Pandavas were thus being agitated on all sides, the Pandavas and the Panchalas, together with the Somakas retreated to a great distance.

sa: नियम्य सहयान द्रौणिः समाश्वास्य च मारिष। रथाश्वनरसम्बाधं कर्णस्य प्राविशद् बलम्॥
en: Then, indeed, O sire, the son of Drona, after having checked his horses and consoled himself entered the army of Karna, that was teemed with cars, horses and men.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा ततो देवा वाक्यमुक्तं महात्मना। गत्वा पितामाहं देवाः प्रसाद्येदं वचोऽब्रुवन्॥
en: Thereupon the celestials, after having listened to these speeches uttered by that highsouled god and also having repaired to the grandsire propitiated him and said to him these words.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं नाराचानां शतैस्त्रिभिः। छादयन् समरे राजन् विव्याध च सुपत्रिभि॥
en: Then, again, O monarch, he (Shrutakarman) covered, with three hundred arrows, him, whose bow was already severed into two pieces and pierced him in the field excellent winged shafts.

sa: मया हस्तवता मुक्ता नाराचा वैद्युतत्विषः। गाण्डीवसृष्टा दास्यन्ति कर्णस्य परमां गतिम्॥
en: My cloth-yard shafts, dazzling with the splendour of lightning, let loose by my capacious arms and from off the strings of Gandiva, will lead Karna to his eternal goal.

sa: स भीमसेनं दशभिः शरैर्विव्याध पाण्डवम्॥ त्रिभिस्त्रिभिर्यमौ वीरौ धर्मराजं च सप्तभिः।
en: Thereupon your son pierced Bhimasena, the son of Pandu, with ten shafts and each of the twins Nakula and Sahadeva with three and the virtuous king Yudhishthira with seven.

sa: नाभ्यनन्दन्त सैन्यानि सात्यकिं तेन कर्मणा। अर्जुनेन हतं पूर्व यजघान कुरूद्वहम्॥
en: The soldiers then did not praise Satyaki for that act of his, viz., the slaughter of the perpetuator of the Kuru race, who already been slain by Pritha's son.

sa: पश्य भीमं महाबाहो रक्षसा ग्रस्तमाहवे। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां तव चैव महाद्युते॥
en: O mighty armed one, behold Bhima as if devoured by the Rakshasa in battle, before the eyes of all troops and before those of yours, O highly effulgent one.

sa: मन्ये चाभ्यधिकं शल्य गुणैः कर्णं धनंजयात्। भवन्तं वासुदेवाश्च लोकोऽयमिति मन्यते॥
en: O sire, even as Karna is reckoned to be superior to Dhananjaya regarding innumerable qualities, so this whole world is of opinion that you are superior to even Vasudeva.

sa: यद्यस्य समरे गोप्ता शक्रो देवगणैः सह। तथाप्येनं निहंस्याव इति कृष्णावभाषताम्॥
en: Even if Indra himself with all the celestials, were to become his protector in battle, yet we shall slay him.” Sanjaya said-Thus did the two Krishna's talk to themselves.

sa: आर्षभं चर्म च महच्छतचन्द्रकसंङ्कुलम्। आविध्य च ततः खङ्गं सात्वतायोत्ससर्ज ह॥
en: And a shield made of bull's hide and decked with a hundred moons. Then whirling that sword in the air, he let it go towards the grandson of Sini.

sa: सौमदत्तेः पुन पो यज्ञशीलस्य धीमतः॥ ध्वजः सूर्य इवाभाति सोमश्चात्र प्रदृश्यते।
en: The standard of Somadatta's son, ever devoted to the performance of sacrifices was decked with the device of a sacrificial stake. It shone like the sun or the moon.

sa: अस्मतोऽभयधिकं कर्णं मन्यमानः प्रशंससि। न चाहं युधि राधेय गणये तुल्यमात्मनः॥
en: You praise Karna by considering that he is superior to ourselves. But I never reckon the son of Radha to be equal to myself in the field of battle.

sa: न्यस्तशस्त्रस्य बालस्य विरथस्य विवर्मणः। अभिमन्योर्वधं तात धार्मिकः को नु पूजयेत्॥
en: But what righteous man is there who will not condemn the slaughter of the body Abhimanyu specially when he was deprived of his weapons, his car and his armour?
